claim: L'Enclume's own rooms are dotted around Cartmel within walking distance of the restaurant; stays Tue–Sat include breakfast at Rogan & Co and a guaranteed L'Enclume table.
quote: All our bedrooms and suites are dotted around Cartmel, within walking distance from us.

claim: The restaurant building dates to the early 13th century and was a family blacksmith until the 1950s; original furnaces, exposed beams and thick stone walls survive.
quote: unique in character, retaining references to the historic surroundings and spotlighting local craftsmanship.

claim: L'Enclume has 16 individually styled bedrooms scattered around Cartmel village.
quote: 16 bedrooms located around the village of Cartmel, each designed in its own unique style while retaining references to the historic surroundings.

claim: Simon Rogan's own boutique-hotel shortlist features L'Enclume and Linthwaite House (which hosts his Henrock restaurant).
quote: L'Enclume … 16 elegant, individually designed, bedrooms located in and around the village of Cartmel.

claim: L'Enclume's accommodations are recognised by the Good Hotel Guide as an inn/with-rooms operation tied to the three-star restaurant.
quote: L'Enclume, Cartmel — Good Hotel Guide expert review.

claim: Guests describe L'Enclume rooms with distinctive period features such as exposed beams in the walls.
quote: Room 11 was upstairs, large with exposed beams in the walls and very characterful.

claim: Aynsome Manor is a 9-room country-house B&B in Cartmel Valley, 15-minute walk from the village, offering a chauffeur service into Cartmel for diners.
quote: chauffeur driven service to nearby Cartmel which boasts three Michelin star restaurants.

claim: The Cavendish Arms is a 450-year-old coaching inn with 10 rooms (Cavendish Loft plus classic/superior/small doubles) just off Cartmel village square.
quote: 450-year-old coaching inn that oozes history from every exposed oak beam.

claim: The Cavendish Arms sits next to the ancient archways of Cartmel Priory, a short stroll from L'Enclume.
quote: nestled next to the ancient archways of Cartmel Priory, just a stone's throw away from … the world-famous L'Enclume.

claim: The Royal Oak has four newly refurbished king-bed en-suite rooms above the pub on Cartmel Square; no in-room TVs.
quote: four newly refurbished, en suite rooms with comfortable king-size beds, located in the centre of Cartmel Square.

claim: Coffee & Stays at Cartmel Square offers four boutique rooms over a licensed café in the village square, with breakfast included; won MyLocalAwards Hotel of the Year.
quote: four gorgeous rooms, each having a view of The Square and includes breakfast each morning.

claim: Holker Estate offers self-catering cottages at Cark in Cartmel, about 2 miles from Cartmel village on the Cavendish family's working estate.
quote: flexibility of being away from it all whilst still within easy reach of … the Medieval Cartmel Village and Racecourse.

claim: Holker Hall has been the seat of the Cavendish family since 1756 and sits about five miles south-west of Cartmel village.
quote: Holker Hall is a country house … home to the Cavendish family since 1756.

claim: The Punch Bowl Inn at Crosthwaite has 10 individually styled rooms named after former vicars of the next-door church, with oak beams and Lyth Valley views.
quote: Nine individually styled rooms with exposed oak beams, stunning views, super comfy beds, flat screen TVs, roll top baths and separate power showers. Named after former vicars of the Church next door.

claim: The Punch Bowl Inn is in the 2026 Michelin Guide United Kingdom.
quote: Punch Bowl Inn – Crosthwaite — a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant.

claim: Linthwaite House (Leeu Collection) is a 36-room hilltop country house overlooking Windermere; on-site Henrock restaurant is run by Simon Rogan's group and the grounds contain a private tarn with row boats.
quote: Henrock, by acclaimed chef Simon Rogan MBE … menus highlighting produce from Simon's regenerative farm in Cartmel Valley.

claim: Gilpin Hotel & Lake House (Crook Road, Windermere) has 38 bedrooms across two estates, many with private hot tubs; SOURCE holds a Michelin star; resident llamas and alpacas.
quote: 30 bedrooms … Gilpin Lake House sits one mile away on its own estate, with eight bedrooms … resident llamas and alpacas.

claim: The Samling is a 12-room boutique 18th-century house overlooking Windermere with consistently high recent ratings.
quote: 18th-century house … entering a new phase of life as an intimate 12-room boutique hotel.

claim: The Samling's restaurant The Gathering holds a Michelin star and sits in a converted outbuilding with whitewashed walls and wooden beams.
quote: It's a Michelin one-star restaurant … The Gathering is a relatively new dining room in a converted outbuilding.

claim: The Samling carries Michelin Hotel Keys recognition in the Michelin Guide.
quote: The Samling Hotel — Ambleside — Book a MICHELIN Guide Hotel.

claim: Road distance Windermere–Cartmel is 14.1 miles; taxi ~23 minutes for ~$40–55.
quote: The road distance is 14.1 miles … A taxi takes 23 minutes … The cost is approximately $40 – $55.

claim: Bowness-on-Windermere to Cartmel is 20.6 km, ~20-minute taxi, €30–45.
quote: 20.6 km … approximately 20 min by taxi … €30–45.

claim: The Swan Hotel & Spa at Newby Bridge is a 4-star riverside hotel with indoor pool, ~5–7 miles from Cartmel.
quote: The Swan Hotel and Spa … in the lake district about 5 minutes' walk from River Leven.

claim: Augill Castle is a 15-bedroom Neo-Gothic castle hotel near Kirkby Stephen in the Upper Eden Valley — about 70+ minutes' drive from Cartmel, outside reasonable taxi range.
quote: Built in 1841, in the Neo-Gothic style, Augill Castle started life as a grand country retreat and is now a luxury hotel.

claim: Royal Oak rooms share breakfast with Cartmel Square B&B across the square; no on-site parking, racecourse machines only take cash.
quote: excellent, hearty breakfast is included in partnership with Cartmel Square B&B located just 50 yards over the square.
